composedModules.ActiveTabIndicator: Rendered inside the catalog's SegmentedTabs example, which owns its positioning contract.
composedModules.Dialog: Rendered through DialogFrame, the public composition that supplies the catalog dialog anatomy.
composedModules.PageSearchInput: Rendered through each DiscoveryFilterBar example so search and recovery behavior stay integrated.
composedModules.RightSidePanel: Rendered through DrawerFrame, which demonstrates the public responsive panel composition.
composedModules.SearchFilterFrame: Rendered through the three DiscoveryFilterBar variants that exercise its responsive layout.

nonVisualModules.formControlStyles: Shared class-name helpers consumed by the catalog's visible form-control primitives.
nonVisualModules.menuStyles: Shared class-name helpers consumed by visible menu triggers, items, and overflow menus.
nonVisualModules.types: TypeScript-only public contracts with no independently renderable catalog surface.
nonVisualModules.useFloatingActionMenu: Behavior hook exercised by the catalog's interactive OverflowActionMenu example.
